messages:
Carol: Quick sync — we need to lock the DevEx roadmap priorities for Q3. OKR anchor: reduce time-to-first-success (TTFS) by 30% and increase sample-app starts by 25%. I put three candidates on the table: 1) Lightweight JS/TS SDK (streaming-first, typed), 2) One-command quickstart that provisions a hosted demo (no infra for the user), 3) A small set of curated sample apps (chat, summarizer, search) with CI, metrics, and tutorial videos. Thoughts?

Alice: +1 on the SDK. Lots of customers ask for a minimal lib they can drop into apps. We should scope the SDK v1 to: auth, streaming, simple retries, and typed responses. No fancy orchestration yet.

Sean: For sample apps — maintenance cost is the killer. Can we template them instead of fully curated repos? e.g., a sample-kit generator that outputs a runnable app with tests. That reduces upkeep.

Maria: Agree on generator. But sales keeps asking for an "enterprise quickstart" that shows Private deployment in 30m. Could we make an "enterprise demo mode" toggle in the quickstart that swaps in VPC hints and a doc path?

Ben: Deployment toggle is fine, but we must be explicit about scope. Quickstart should not actually provision infra for Private customers. Instead: interactive walkthrough + reproducible scripts. Launch criteria: docs + walkthrough, CI passing, 1 end-to-end tutorial video, and telemetry events emitted (sample_start, sample_success).

Carol: Good constraints. Let's be conservative for Q1 of the roadmap: SDK v1 (public), Quickstart generator (hosted demo mode), Sample-kit generator (3 templates). Add enterprise walkthrough as stretch.

Alice: UX asks: SDK should include an opinionated default prompt template and an examples folder. Also: single-page quickstarts in the docs (one scroll).

Sean: Telemetry: we need an event schema. Minimal fields: user_id (opt-in), sample_id, template, success_bool, duration_ms. Can the platform emit these to our Console usage dashboard? @devex-bot can we track that?

devex-bot: Noted: add telemetry schema to the "devex/telemetry" RFC. Assign to @Sean for draft.

Maria: Customer-driven asks prioritized by ARR impact: 1) Types + streaming (high), 2) Enterprise quickstart (medium), 3) notebook+colab quickstart (low). Sales will give top-5 accounts asking for onboarding help — I'll follow up.

Carol: OKR alignment check: which of these map to measurable key results? Proposal: a) TTFS down 30% (tracked via telemetry), b) sample-app starts +25%, c) SDK adoption (>= 5 internal + 10 external quickstarts run in first month). If we can't measure, we can't claim progress.

Ben: Suggestion on launch criteria (formal): - README + quickstart guide, - 90% of CI checks green, - telemetry schema instrumented, - 3 user-facing docs (how-to, troubleshooting, api ref), - at least one tutorial video <5m.

Alice: Timeline ask: can we do SDK v1 alpha in 6 weeks? I think yes if we scope aggressively and reuse internal infra. Need a maintainer and one engineer full-time for 4 weeks + swarming for API edge cases.

Carol: Who can lead SDK? @Alice? Who owns sample-kit? @Sean? We need an owner for quickstarts/guide docs — @Maria?

Maria: I can own docs/playbooks and coordinate with Solutions for enterprise walkthroughs. I'll gather sales asks by Friday.

Sean: I'll prototype a generator using the existing sample templates and Yeoman-like CLI. ETA: 3 weeks for prototype, 6 weeks for polished generator.

Alice: I'll take SDK lead. Plan: week1 API shape + types, week2 streaming POC, week3 tests + examples, week4 polish + docs.

Carol: Great — next steps: 1) Owners declared (Alice, Sean, Maria), 2) Draft launch criteria doc (Ben will draft), 3) Telemetry RFC (Sean), 4) Roadmap entry for product planning sync on Monday. I'll update the roadmap board after this thread.

Ben: I'll drop a launch-criteria PR into the devex repo by EOD Wednesday.

Maria: Sales ask: I'll post the top accounts and the specific onboarding blockers once I hear back.

Carol: Solid. If no major objections, I'll mark this as the Q3 devex priorities and spin up tasks. :thumbsup:

Sean: :eyes: ping me if you want the proto earlier.

Alice: :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Created task "devex/sdk-v1" assigned to Alice, due 6 weeks from thread_ts.
